Name: Sunfish Invasion
Author: literaltree
Description:
[size=3][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Joke mod, removes every fish (configurable) from the game except for sunfish.[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Changes spawning location for sunfish to everywhere.[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Edits recipes to be more sunfish-friendly (configurable).[/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest version of SMAPI, Content Patcher, and BETAS.[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the contents into your mods folder.[/color][/size]
